exposure: rate of opportunistic salpingectomy use among peer physicians in the same patient-sharing network at baseline
outcome: opportunistic salpingectomy uptake at the time of postpartum and interval sterilizations
cohort: Participants were patients aged 18 to 49 years who underwent a tubal sterilization after childbirth or unrelated to pregnancy between January 2020 and December 2022, whose operating surgeon had not performed opportunistic salpingectomy at baseline (2017-2019).
finding: Surgeons who previously shared patients with other physicians exhibiting high rates of opportunistic salpingectomy use were significantly more likely to adopt opportunistic salpingectomy in their own subsequent practice.
